title: Rust rf_health: adaptive_sf_select step-3 density 10 -> 8 + post-step-6 floors a-d (spec 2a.8 parity with C)
description: Child of b7z9.30 (cross-impl parity: spec requires ALL implementations produce identical results). rust/lichen-core/src/rf_health.rs adaptive_sf_select has the same gaps the C gradient.c had: (1) step 3 uses density > 10 instead of spec's > 8 (line ~423; DENSITY_HIGH=8 const exists); (2) post-step-6 minimum-SF floors a-d absent (a. snr_ema < -5 -> 12; b. snr_ema < 0 -> max(11); c. density > 8 -> max(11); d. load_factor_fp >= 52429 -> max(11)). Floors use self state (snr_ema from self.snr.avg(), load_factor_fp field) so no signature change. Fix doc comment 2a.7 -> 2a.8 + floors. Extend the inline tests (adaptive_sf_and_rebalance_matches_spec stays green: its cases are floor-compatible) with a new floors test incl the 52429/52428 load boundary and EMA-convergence sampling for floor a (record_rx(-6) x N until avg < -5). Land after/independently of the C children .1/.2 (same spec rows). Discovered from project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.30.
close_reason: Rust mirror of the C gradient SF conformance (spec 02a 2a.8) landed in rust/lichen-core/src/rf_health.rs: (1) adaptive_sf_select step 3 density threshold 10 -> DENSITY_HIGH (8), matching the landed C fix (worker6-b7z9.30.1) and spec; (2) post-step-6 minimum-SF floors a-d added in spec order with each MAX against the running SF, driven by self state: a. snr_ema < SNR_CRITICAL(-5) -> sf=12; b. snr_ema < SNR_POOR(0) -> max(11,sf); c. density > DENSITY_HIGH(8) -> max(11,sf); d. load_factor_fp >= FLOOR_LOAD_FP(52429 = 0.8 Q16.16 ceil, distinct from LOAD_HIGH's floor-truncated 52428) -> max(11,sf); (3) doc comments updated 2a.7 -> 2a.8 in both adaptive_sf_select and the sibling adaptive_sf (reviewer P4); (4) tests: adaptive_sf_density_threshold_is_eight (boundary 8/9) and adaptive_sf_floors_apply_in_order (floor a via EMA driven to < -5 through record_rx, floor b at -2, floor c, floor d, clean-state control) — 363 lib tests all green including the pre-existing adaptive_sf_and_rebalance_matches_spec. fmt clean, clippy -D warnings clean for the file. Codereview: security pass (Kimi K3) — 1 pre-existing latent finding (assigned_sf/return unclamped to [7,12]; currently test-only callers, future DIO wiring would pass attacker bytes) filed as worker6-5m15; edge pass PASS with one P4 fixed (stale 2a.7 doc on adaptive_sf); correctness pass timed out mid-run (reviewer latency) — completed via worker-loop fallback self-review: floor order/MAX semantics verified by the new ordered tests, no behavior change to the pre-existing spec-matching test (suite green), FLOOR_LOAD_FP ceil-vs-floor distinction confirmed against LOAD_HIGH and the bead's 52429 constant. C/Rust parity: C floors mirror is worker6-b7z9.30.2 (worker-2).
